rows: No shortcut. No second opinion. Just the hold.
Brawling is a condition. State its limits and I will show you mine.
Risk, to me, is a condition too. Write it down and I will meet it.
Pace is a condition. It is set by the rules, and I will keep to them.
The people are owed a clean contest. That is the only condition I need.
The rules are clear, and I will play by them.
I earn my place on the card. I do not borrow it.
Check the stance is clean. Clean and legal.
Technique is your favourite word. State the rule that applies to your hold, then show me.
Strikes are allowed within the limits. Stay inside them.
Risk, to me, is fine if it is clean. Is yours?
A stall is a delay with no rule behind it. I do not accept it.
The people want a clean result. Set the condition and I will meet it.
Among the best, you say, in a clean sense. Show the clean record, or say nothing.
You are proud of your {strength}. Keep it clean. It is a legal strength. Show me it stays legal.
I have checked your {strength} against the rules, and I want a clean answer to one point.
You stayed within the lines. Within the rules, then. Calm is within the rules.
Agreed within limits. That is a clean point, and I accept it.
I could question your integrity. I will not do it without evidence, so I will test you instead.
One fall, clean, and no more. Clean finish, no excuses. Keep me down and the result is clean.
On the mat we both stay inside the limits. That is the test.
Grounded or standing, the limits do not change.
Stay in front of me and show me a clean hold.
A clean answer. It is inside the rules.
No clean reply yet. A clean answer, please.
A clean point, I accept. We test it at the bell, cleanly.
I will fight this match cleanly, and I will not look for an edge outside the rules.
My approach is clean. You can see it in the hold.
Whatever happens, the result will be clean.
It is not over. The rules still apply.
I have one condition left. You will hear it when the bell rings.
I cannot demonstrate a breach of the rules. It would be wrong to maintain that charge against you.
The rules apply to my conduct as well. I haven't established the allegation, and I withdraw it.
Good. We can leave that allegation behind and keep the contest within the rules.
Accepted. No charge to answer there. Now give me a clean match.
A legal hold, a legal escape, a legal finish. All three can be observed.
The referee can enforce the rules and record the result. That is a fair test; an accusation is not.
